citations.title: NIFREL with Kids & Expo Park: Full-Day Osaka Guide
citations.content:
NIFREL with kids takes roughly 1.5–2 hours at a comfortable pace. The facility is entirely indoors with nursing rooms and diaper-changing stations on both floors (note: only one nursing seat per floor — expect waits on weekends). No hot water for formula — bring your own. Coin lockers on 1F (¥200–400) store bags. Strollers are allowed but a carrier works better — many tanks sit at child eye level, making them hard to see from a seated stroller. Temporary stroller parking is set up on busy days for the “Behavior” zone.

...
